title: ALTER rename callbacks and schema reload

scope.rationale: The ALTER analysis owner now exposes source-shaped callbacks for token unmapping, SELECT traversal, quote-fix collection, rename-token destruction, and VDBE schema reload sequencing.

dependencies.caller_closure: The functions own their complete callback, cleanup, and schema-reload responsibilities; higher-level ALTER compilation remains separate.

inputs: Source-layout Parse, Walker, Expr, Select, RenameToken, and database index values
outputs: Remapped or collected tokens, released token lists, and ordered SetCookie/ParseSchema operations
contracts.ownership: Token-list cleanup consumes every node; callbacks borrow parser trees.
contracts.state_and_results: Callbacks return source walker controls and schema reload includes TEMP for non-TEMP databases.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: No direct I/O; schema reload appends VDBE operations under parser ownership.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Callbacks and destructor allocate nothing; absent VDBE makes reload a no-op.

representation_differences: Typed Zig callbacks use the repository's source-layout parser structures and canonical Opcode enum.

oracle.protocol: Exercise callbacks and operation shaping through the broad repository runtime suite.
oracle.normalization: Compare source-visible state transitions rather than allocation addresses.

assurance.malformed_input: Requires source-valid parser graph and database index invariants.
assurance.continuation: Consumed token lists cannot be reused; parser operations remain executable.
assurance.performance: Linear in token list or CTE count; constant schema-operation count.

integration.native_call_path: ALTER analysis and compiler helpers -> typed callbacks/destructor/schema reload

known_blockers: Complete higher-level ALTER compiler wiring and focused pinned-C trace.

implementation_spans: Adjacent rename walker and VDBE helper contracts
upstream_tests: Project broad runtime and ALTER schema differential tests
